description: Find a country's top trading partners ranked by trade volume. Returns partner countries and total trade values. Defaults to ANNUAL; pass frequency="monthly" for a single month's ranking instead of the last full year's.

cmd_code.description: Alias for hs_code — HS commodity code. Use this OR hs_code, not both.

commodity.description: Alias for hs_code — HS commodity code. Use this OR hs_code, not both.

commodity_code.description: Alias for hs_code — HS commodity code (e.g. "2603" for copper ores). Use this OR hs_code, not both.

flow.description: Trade flow: "M" for imports, "X" for exports

frequency.description: Data frequency: "annual" (default) or "monthly". Monthly coverage is thinner — not every reporter files monthly, and recent months lag; a reporter with no filing for the requested month is absent from the ranking, not shown at zero. When "monthly", pass `year` as YYYYMM.

hs.description: Alias for hs_code — HS commodity code. Use this OR hs_code, not both.

hs_code.description: Optional HS commodity code to filter by specific product (e.g. "2603" for copper ores) — omit for all commodities (TOTAL). Aliases accepted: commodity_code, commodity, hs, cmd_code (pass exactly one).

limit.description: Number of top partners to return (default 20)

reporter_code.description: Country name (e.g. "USA", "China") or UN numeric code (842=US). Names resolved automatically.

year.description: Trade period. For frequency="annual" (default): a year, e.g. "2024". For frequency="monthly": year+month as YYYYMM, e.g. "202401".

name: comtrade_top_partners

total_partners.description: Total number of top partners returned

title: Comtrade Top Partners
